We evaluate our method by adapting a black-box model to three distinct domains and a downstream task-machine translation (MT)... For downstream evaluation, we experiment on English-Czech and English-German MT using the WMT21 dataset.

In this work, we experiment on several datasets and a downstream task, as well as performing extensive analysis of our method, reaching several conclusions: • By combining a small domain expert and a large black-box model, the combined model outperforms either of the original ones in all cases, by as much as 9% perplexity for domain adaptation, and 6% BLEURT for MT, showing the effectiveness of our approach.
outputs: Generated translations for machine translation; next-token probabilities for language modeling

The paper evaluates generated outputs in machine translation and domain-adapted language modeling, where the combined model generates text continuations or translations by leveraging a black-box LM and a fine-tuned small LM.
